frame: A plain staircase of ten steps with a plain handrail, seen from the side and rising to the right, with a flat landing at the top and a flat floor at the bottom. One adult in plain clothes, same size in every drawing. Only the step the adult stands on changes.
sentence_nl: Mijn zoon staat bovenaan, mijn dochter onderaan en ik sta halverwege.
sentence_en: My son is standing at the top, my daughter at the bottom and I am standing halfway.

frame: A plain car seen from straight above with its roof removed, so four seats show in two rows, on a plain road. A driver sits at the wheel in the front left seat. One child in plain clothes, same size in every drawing. Only the seat the child occupies changes.
sentence_nl: Mijn zoon zit achterin, maar mijn vrouw zit voorin.
sentence_en: My son is sitting in the back, but my wife is sitting in the front.

frame: A plain wide street seen from the front as a flat strip with a plain kerb at each side and a plain wall far behind. One cyclist rides toward the viewer down the middle, still far off. One adult in plain clothes, whole-figure, same size in every drawing. Only the place of the adult changes: mid-street, or up on the kerb.
sentence_nl: Hij staat midden op straat, maar nu gaat hij opzij.
sentence_en: He is standing in the middle of the street, but now he steps aside.

frame: One plain mug with a handle, seen from the side, stands on a plain table with a plain wall behind, same size on the page. Only the way the mug stands changes: on its base, or on its rim.
sentence_nl: Deze beker staat rechtop, maar die beker staat ondersteboven.
sentence_en: This mug is standing upright, but that mug is upside down.

frame: One adult cycles on a plain upright bicycle seen from the side, riding right, on a flat road with a plain low wall behind. The bike carries two small child seats: one at the handlebar, one over the back wheel. Only the seat the child sits in changes.
sentence_nl: Mijn dochter zit niet meer voorop, maar achterop.
sentence_en: My daughter no longer sits on the front, but on the back.

frame: A cutaway landscape seen from the side: a flat ground surface with a row of plain houses and a railway track on it, and below it, deep in the earth, a round tunnel with a second track. One metro train, same size in every drawing. Only the place of the train changes.
sentence_nl: Hier rijdt de metro ondergronds, daar rijdt hij bovengronds.
sentence_en: Here the metro runs underground, there it runs above ground.

frame: One adult in a winter coat on a frozen pavement, seen from the side, with a plain low wall and one bare tree behind and a few small ice patches on the ground, same size on the page. Only the adult's body changes: still on both feet, or feet flying off the ice.
sentence_nl: Op het ijs blijft hij eerst overeind, maar dan gaat hij onderuit.
sentence_en: On the ice he stays on his feet at first, but then he falls over.

frame: One adult sits on a plain wooden chair with a backrest, seen from the side and facing right, both feet flat on the floor and both hands resting on the thighs, plain wall behind, same size on the page. Only the lean of the upper body changes.
sentence_nl: Op de stoel leunt hij niet achterover, maar voorover.
sentence_en: On the chair he does not lean back, but forward.

frame: A tall plain cupboard seen from the front with both doors open, showing five plain empty shelves from floor to top. One plain mug with a handle, same size in every drawing, stands on one shelf. Only the shelf the mug stands on changes.
sentence_nl: De beker staat niet meer bovenin, maar onderin.
sentence_en: The mug is no longer at the top, but at the bottom.
